extName.description: Store listing name and the name in chrome://extensions. Max 75 characters.

extShortName.description: Short name where space is tight. Max 12 characters.

extDescription.message: Save pages, links, quotes and screenshots to your second brain in one click. Machina summarizes and sorts every save for you.
extDescription.description: Store listing summary and manifest description. Max 132 characters.

menuScreenshot.message: A screenshot of what you see

queuedRateDetail.message: That was a lot of saves at once. Machina will send this one in a few minutes.

tokenHelp.message: Use this if one-click connect isn't available. In Machina on the web, open Settings, then Browser extension, then Advanced, and copy the token.

tokenBadFormat.message: That doesn't look like a Machina token. Copy it again from Settings in Machina.

tokenInvalid.message: Machina didn't recognize this token. It may have been reset; copy the current one.

tokenOffline.message: You're offline. Connect again when you're back online.

tokenServer.message: Machina hit a problem. Try again in a moment.

tokenRateLimited.message: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.

tokenUnexpected.message: Machina answered in a way this version doesn't understand. Try again later.

shortcutsHelp.message: Shortcuts are set on the browser's own shortcuts page. If one shows as not set, another extension or the browser already uses those keys.

queueEmpty.message: Nothing is waiting. Every save reached Machina.

queueDiscardLabel.description: Accessible label for a discard button.

queueExpired.message: Gave up after a day of tries.

privacyBody.message: Machina reads a page only when you save it, and sends only what that save needs: the address and title, any text you selected, the post preview on Instagram and TikTok, or the screenshot you asked for. It sends nothing about pages you don't save, and it keeps its connection token on this computer.
